label: Reolink Video Doorbell PoE (2K+)
description: Reolink Video Doorbell PoE is a 2K+ wired doorbell camera with two-way audio, person/vehicle detection and a bundled chime. It has exactly one network interface: a single 10/100 Mbps RJ45 port fed by IEEE 802.3af (48 V active) PoE, with no Wi-Fi radio at all - one cable carries both power and the RTSP/ONVIF stream, and the alternative install is 12 V DC or existing doorbell wiring for power only.
